Description: Defines the identity of the P3 Code deposit for ResearchBox 8834 / AsPredicted 307342 / run p3-20260819T192700Z-92d63d4. The Code bingo cell documents confirmatory software under scripts/p3/ only (never scripts/p1/env.sh or scripts/p2/env.sh), pinned to nanochat commit 92d63d4e8bb4df75c3b71618f31ddde2378b2bcd. The companion full-file inventory is p3_code_crosswalk.csv (41 files with sha2-256 digests). Use this variable to keep P3 code provenance separate from P1.1 box 8735 and P2 box 8763.

Names the two shell entrypoints that configure the P3 tree before gates run: env.sh (CPU/local Gates A-G after Gate 0; forbids P1/P2 environments) and env.cuda.sh (named NVIDIA host for Gates H-W; prefers clean staging paths data/staging/en-clean and data/staging/b3-clean after the Gate S missing-data recovery). They set NANOCHAT_FILIPINO_ROOT and NANOCHAT_DATA_DIR, activate the uv-synced Linux venv on CUDA hosts, and keep confirmatory mounts free of ClimbMix and P1.1/P2 checkpoint write targets. Operational provenance only, not scientific outcomes.

Groups library modules imported by later scripts: p3_common.py (paths, hashes, LOCK/access counters; emits no BPB outcomes), phase2_common.py (B1/B2/B3 equal-budget constants), and forbidden_parents.py (rejects P1.1/P2/d8/wrong-path parents so phase-two arms resume only from frozen B0). These encode freshness and common-parent rules in code. They appear in Code.zip under scripts_p3/ with digests in the full crosswalk.

Identifies evaluate_bpb.py as the sole confirmatory dependent-variable implementation. BPB equals mean token NLL divided by (ln(2) times mean UTF-8 bytes per token), with T=2048, BOS-best-fit packing, full validation (or authorized Gate V holdouts), and special-token exclusion per AsPredicted. Used by P0-T, Gate U, and Gate V. In-loop trainer meta.val_bpb is never a primary DV. Reconstruct tables from this evaluator or its sealed JSON, not Hugging Face Trainer or truncated --eval-tokens slices.

Covers Gate 0 / lockbox acceptance: gate0_accept.py plus nonconfirmatory dummies dummy_p0t.py and dummy_b2_test.py. They verify opaque outcome containers, access counters, and break-glass templates before any real P3 BPB exists, and document the one-person-lab contract (outcome access starts at zero; raw test text stays outside training directories). Dummy scripts are engineering tests only and must not appear in confirmatory result tables.

Crosswalks the CPU freeze chain before TL0: gate_a_source_pin.py (pin), gate_b_raw_assets.py (corpus SHA identity), gate_c_hygiene.py (no ClimbMix; tests absent from train mounts), gate_d_split_freeze.py (filed train/val/test hashes), gate_e_shards.py (packed streams and B3 50/50-document mix frozen before TL0 validation), gate_f_tokenizer.py (fresh P3 Tagalog 32768 BPE), gate_g_budget.py (N=294, B=65536, T=2048, warmup/LR rules). Pass/fail receipts live under Other/; these scripts produced them.

Describes Gate H CUDA smoke: gate_h_preflight.py, gate_h_smoke.sh, and gate_h_accept.py. Short Tagalog-path d4 smoke on the named A40 proves the CUDA stack. Explicitly nonconfirmatory: smoke tags must not be p3-tl0-*; d4 must not enter the primary arm table; CORE stays off. Prevents mistaking H for TL0 or for depth selection.

Maps Gate I software that trains fresh Tagalog parent TL0 at d8 and d20 under the frozen budget: gate_i_preflight.py, gate_i_tl0.sh, gate_i_accept.py. Enforces Tagalog-only active data (p3-tl39-active), final-checkpoint selection (not mid-run val-best), zero English tokens during TL0, and terminal step/hash acceptance. Frozen d20 becomes B0; d8 exists for P0-T dual-depth eligibility only.

Documents P0-T scripts gate_p0t_preflight.py, gate_p0t.sh, and gate_p0t_accept.py. They require TL0 at both d8 and d20 to beat an untrained same-depth model and a train-fitted add-1 UTF-8 byte unigram by at least 0.01 BPB on Tagalog validation under the P3 tokenizer, before any English child token. During blinding operators see PASS/BLOCKED only. BLOCKED would forbid B1/B2/B3; this run followed PASS.

Covers Gate Q and phase-two orchestration: gate_q_b0_freeze.py (freeze TL0 d20 as B0 with parent whitelist), gate_q_to_w.sh (blinded Q-to-W driver), gate_resume_s_to_w.sh (resume after Gate S recovery without partial optimizer state), gate_phase2_accept.py (shared B1/B2/B3 checks: parent SHA, step 294, fresh optimizer, finite health). Encodes equal-exposure continuation and the official Gate S disposition (quarantined partial attempt; clean B0 restart).

Identifies arm launchers and shared trainer: gate_r_b1.sh (extra Tagalog B1), gate_s_b2.sh (English B2 on WT103-raw/en-clean), gate_t_b3.sh (pre-frozen 50/50-document mix B3, not mitigation), continue_from_frozen.py (B0 weights, load_optimizer=False, fresh Muon+AdamW, peak LR 0.3x TL0, warmup 14, exactly 294 steps / D_phase2=19267584). Code embodiment of the filed comparison: stream identity differs; budget, parent, tokenizer, and optimizer-freshness do not.

Groups Gate U sealing: gate_u_seal.py and make_validation_seal.py. They evaluate six child cells B1/B2/B3 x {Tagalog, English} plus descriptive B0 English val_bpb_full, write the sealed bundle, and require test_access=0 at seal. B0 English is excluded from C_tl, G_en, and B3 contrasts. Must not read legacy tests; that is Gate V after the seal timestamp.

Describes gate_v_test.py, the only confirmatory test-touch program: one authorized event, B2 d20 only, exactly two legacy holdouts (English WT103-raw test manifest; Tagalog P1.1 test.jsonl), secondary to validation contrasts, forbidden for B1/B3, leaves sealed C_tl/G_en unchanged. Increments test_access 0 to 1. Must never republish P1.1 1.164768 or P2 Gate V numbers as P3 results.

Identifies gate_w_closeout.py, which writes the closeout manifest of artifact roles, sizes, and hashes after U/V without new training, validation, or test science. May prepare ResearchBox/GitHub packaging lists but cannot invent metrics or reopen arms. Treat W receipts as stewardship metadata, not a second analysis.

Maps Gate X software: gate_x_preflight.py, gate_x_unblind.py, release_bundle.py. Preflight is status/hash/count only (Q-W PASS, U-before-V, B2-only V, Gate S disposition, zero prior outcome access, safe-log scan) and must not open scalars. Unblind writes P3_UNBLINDING_EVENT.json, opens the sealed package once into released/, sets p3_outcome_access_count=1, keeps raw_test_still_restricted=true, and freezes further confirmatory eval.

Records break_glass.py as the dated deviation/break-glass writer for crashes, SHA mismatches, NaN/Inf, lockbox failures, or path leaks. Preserves evidence; forbids silent repair via a new confirmatory path. For P3, the Gate S English-data failure was a quarantined partial attempt then an official clean B0 restart. Keeps incidents auditable without rewriting AsPredicted 307342.

Explains how to use this three-column codebook with Code.zip and p3_code_crosswalk.csv. Upload THIS file when ResearchBox wants a compact codebook (17 rows, 3 columns). Use the 41-row digest crosswalk for bit-level file identity. Do not classify .py/.sh as Data. Do not include .env, passcodes, HOST SSH cards, .pt weights, or raw test.jsonl in Code. Hex digests are file SHA-256 (often prefixed sha2-256:) and are not participant IDs; P3 has no human subjects. AsCollected https://ascollected.org/F36_C2C covers public-data provenance separately.
